import p2helpers as m,json,secrets,re,hashlib,base64,time
from pathlib import Path
W=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;R=W.parents[1];m.WORK=W/'run';m.WORK.mkdir(exist_ok=True);m.STAGE='local-only-Prisma-runtime-gate-correction';image='sha256:bd294744d685f962f634ca24f8b66c124f1b37d8fc91a8128e42854a73e2ca14'
m.REPORT={'phase':m.STAGE,'base':'75955bb44eb2ba86da7d2c5f30ec947373e5099e','commands':[],'checks':[],'ownedContainers':[],'removedContainers':[],'qaAccess':False,'productionAccess':False,'realBackupOrCredentialRead':False,'syntheticDatabaseOnly':True}
pwds={role:secrets.token_hex(32) for role in ['kortek_migrator','kortek_runtime']};m.PRIVATE_VALUES.extend(pwds.values());database='p3_gate_local'
def login(db,text,role='kortek_migrator',expected=0):
 return m.docker('exec','-i','-e','PGPASSWORD','-e','PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8',db,'psql','-X','-qAt','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-h','127.0.0.1','-U',role,'-d',database,data=text.encode(),env=dict(m.BASE_ENV,PGPASSWORD=pwds[role]),expected=expected,label='local-SCRAM-psql-'+role).decode()
def node_container(db,role,suffix,password=None):
 name='kortek-p3-gate-'+suffix+'-'+m.RUN;url='postgresql://'+role+':'+(password or pwds[role])+'@127.0.0.1:5432/'+database+'?schema=public';m.PRIVATE_VALUES.append(url)
 m.docker('run','--detach','--rm','--platform','linux/arm64','--name',name,'--network','container:'+db,'--read-only','--cpus','2','--memory','1024m','--tmpfs','/tmp:rw,size=64m','-e','DATABASE_URL','--entrypoint','sleep',image,'infinity',env=dict(m.BASE_ENV,DATABASE_URL=url),label='local-image-private-PG-namespace-'+suffix);m.OWNED.append(name);m.REPORT['ownedContainers'].append(name);return name
def gate(node,success,label):
 raw=m.docker('exec','-i',node,'node','-',data=(W/'runtime-gate.cjs').read_bytes(),timeout=180,expected=0 if success else 1,label=label).decode();parsed=json.loads(raw.strip().splitlines()[-1]) if raw.strip() else None
 if success:assert parsed=={'runtimeGate37':True,'role':'kortek_runtime','tables':37,'readonly':'on'}
 m.REPORT.setdefault('nodeGateCases',[]).append({'case':label,'expectedSuccess':success,'stdout':parsed,'exitCode':0 if success else 1,'sameGateScriptSha256':hashlib.sha256((W/'runtime-gate.cjs').read_bytes()).hexdigest()});m.save()
try:
 db=m.start('kortek-p3-local-synthetic-db-'+m.RUN,server=True)
 for role,pwd in pwds.items():m.local_sql(db,'CREATE ROLE '+m.ident(role)+' LOGIN NOINHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS PASSWORD '+m.literal(pwd)+';')
 m.local_sql(db,'CREATE DATABASE '+database+' OWNER kortek_migrator; REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE '+database+' FROM PUBLIC; GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE '+database+' TO kortek_runtime;')
 m.local_sql(db,'ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO kortek_migrator; REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO kortek_runtime;',database=database)
 m.docker('exec','-i','--user','postgres',db,'sh','-c','cat > /var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_hba.conf',data=b'local all all trust\nhost all all 127.0.0.1/32 scram-sha-256\nhost all all ::1/128 scram-sha-256\n',label='local-only-SCRAM-loopback-hba')
 m.docker('exec','--user','postgres',db,'pg_ctl','-D','/var/lib/postgresql/data','reload',label='own-local-reload')
 migrator=node_container(db,'kortek_migrator','migrator')
 raw=m.docker('exec',migrator,'node','node_modules/prisma/build/index.js','migrate','deploy',timeout=240,label='all-28-migrations-synthetic-isolated-image-only').decode();m.REPORT['migrationDeployOutputRedacted']=m.sanitize_message(raw);m.emit('local-synthetic-schema28-created')
 for file in ['apply-runtime-grants.sql','customer-stage-one-runtime-grants.sql']:
  text=(R/'apps/api/ops'/file).read_text();effective=re.sub(r'^\\ir [^\r\n]+\r?\n?', '',text,flags=re.M);assert '\\ir' not in effective;login(db,effective)
 ledger=json.loads(login(db,'SELECT json_build_object(\'active\',count(*) FILTER(WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL),\'failed\',count(*) FILTER(WHERE finished_at IS NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL)) FROM "_prisma_migrations";'));assert ledger=={'active':28,'failed':0};m.REPORT['syntheticLedger']=ledger
 login(db,(R/'apps/api/ops/verify-runtime-role.sql').read_text(),role='kortek_runtime');m.check('existing-psql-gate-passes-local-restricted-login')
 runtime=node_container(db,'kortek_runtime','runtime');gate(runtime,True,'unchanged-Prisma-adapted-gate-positive-restricted-login')
 login(db,'GRANT UPDATE ON "CustomerOperation" TO kortek_runtime;');gate(runtime,False,'same-gate-rejects-extra-receipt-update-privilege')
 login(db,'REVOKE UPDATE ON "CustomerOperation" FROM kortek_runtime;');gate(runtime,True,'gate-passes-after-repair-only-synthetic-database')
 wrong=node_container(db,'kortek_runtime','wrong-password',password=secrets.token_hex(32));gate(wrong,False,'same-gate-rejects-wrong-runtime-password')
 # Execute exact corrected watchdog script with a local synthetic command endpoint.
 stub=b'#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -Eeuo pipefail\n[[ "$#" == 2 ]]\n[[ "$1" == /home/opc/kortek-api-staging/p3-bc1d559/qa-manager.py && "$2" == rollback ]]\nprintf "SYNTHETIC_MANAGER_RECEIVED_ROLLBACK\\n"\n';(W/'synthetic-python-command.sh').write_bytes(stub)
 out=m.docker('run','-i','--rm','--platform','linux/arm64','--name','kortek-p3-watchdog-dispatch-'+m.RUN,'--network','none','--read-only','--tmpfs','/tmp:rw','-v',str(W/'synthetic-python-command.sh')+':/usr/bin/python3:ro','--entrypoint','bash',image,'-s',data=(W/'qa-rollback.sh').read_bytes(),timeout=60,label='unchanged-LF-watchdog-script-dispatch-to-local-synthetic-manager').decode();assert out.strip()=='SYNTHETIC_MANAGER_RECEIVED_ROLLBACK';m.REPORT['watchdogDispatch']={'sameCorrectedScriptSha256':hashlib.sha256((W/'qa-rollback.sh').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'stdout':out.strip(),'localOnly':True,'syntheticManagerCommand':True,'realSystemdDeadlineOrQaRollbackTested':False}
 m.REPORT['success']=True;m.REPORT['meaningfulLocalGateCorrectionVerified']=True
except Exception as error:m.retain_failure(error);m.emit('local-correction-drill-failed',failure=m.failure_info(error))
finally:
 m.PRIVATE_VALUES.clear();m.cleanup();m.REPORT['finishedUtc']=m.datetime.now(m.timezone.utc).isoformat();m.save();print(json.dumps({'localCorrectionDrillSuccess':m.REPORT.get('success',False),'qaAccess':False,'remainingOwnedContainers':m.REPORT['remainingOwnedContainers'],'report':str(m.WORK/'result.json')}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if m.REPORT.get('success') else 1)

credentials_dir=${CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY:?systemd credentials required}
set -a
source "$credentials_dir/runtime-env"
set +a
[[ ${DATABASE_URL:-} =~ ^postgresql://kortek_runtime\.prirlabbnlcuvnzuaczp: ]]
[[ ${DEPLOY_ENV:-} == staging && ${NODE_ENV:-} == production ]]
exec /usr/bin/podman run --rm --name kortek-p3-runtime-gate-bc1d559 --network host --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --cpus 0.5 --memory 512m --pids-limit 96 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m -e DATABASE_URL -v /home/opc/kortek-api-staging/supabase-ca.crt:/srv/kortek/apps/api/prisma/supabase-ca.crt:ro,z -v /home/opc/kortek-api-staging/p3-bc1d559/runtime-gate.cjs:/tmp/runtime-gate.cjs:ro,z --entrypoint node sha256:807bcb442a69e74198b224d1e60c9ae8d678043a6c7d070e90ace80935d8a261 /tmp/runtime-gate.cjs
